title: Style
description: Style references shared by every level of the cascade (M1.3). Pack tokens are a plain token tree; the pack format is M2.1.

overrides.title: StyleOverrides
overrides.description: Token overrides at this level, one wrapper per token path (convention 7).

level_style.description: Token overrides at a sequence, scene, shot or layer. Only the project chooses a pack.
level_style.title: LevelStyle
